$comment: Single source of truth for the Progress API. Every framework package is tested against this file.
name: progress
title: Progress
description: A bar that shows how far a task has got.

value.description: 0–100. Leave it out while the amount is unknown: the bar slides (indeterminate).

label.description: Shown above the bar and used as its name.

showValue.description: Show the percentage next to the label.

examples.title: With a label
examples.description: A label and the percentage above the bar. Turn it green when the task is done.

examples.title: Unknown length
examples.description: While you can't say how far along it is, leave out the value: the bar slides.

a11y: role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, -min and -max: screen readers say the percentage.
Every bar has a name: the visible label (aria-labelledby) or an aria-label.
An indeterminate bar has no aria-valuenow, which tells screen readers the amount is unknown.
The sliding bar stops when motion is off.
